metadata.name: c_vault
metadata.description: c_vault v1.1.0 — On-chain multi-fund index vault (ETF-style) for Solana

instructions.name: add_eligible_base_mint
docs: Add a company-approved stable mint to the eligible base_mint allowlist.

instructions.name: claim
docs: Instruction 3 of 3 — send pending USDC to user and close RedeemState.

accounts.name: treasury_usdc_account
docs: Platform fee slice destination — treasury's USDC ATA.

instructions.name: create_etf
docs: Create a new ETF fund vault, including its Token-2022 share metadata,
in a single transaction. The new vault's id is always
`global_state.total_vaults`; PDA seeds are derived from it directly. The
counter is incremented by 1 once the vault is initialised.

accounts.name: global_state
docs: Program-wide singleton — must already be initialised via init_global_state.
`total_vaults` is read here (pre-handler) to derive this vault's PDA seeds.

accounts.name: vault
docs: The new vault state PDA, keyed by the current global vault counter.

accounts.name: vault_authority
docs: Per-vault PDA that signs CPIs on behalf of this vault.

accounts.name: shares_mint
docs: Share (LP) token mint for this vault — Token-2022. Created manually in the
handler (not via Anchor's `init` + `mint::…` macro) because the
`MetadataPointer` extension must be initialized *before* `InitializeMint2`,
and this workspace's anchor-spl (0.31.0) doesn't yet support declaring
mint extensions through the account macro (added in 0.31.1).
mint (with MetadataPointer extension) in the handler below.

accounts.name: usdc_vault
docs: USDC token account custodied by this vault.

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: The USDC mint (base currency for all deposits and redemptions).

accounts.name: shares_token_program
docs: Token-2022 program — used for the share mint.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: Classic SPL Token program — used for the USDC vault account.

instructions.name: deposit
docs: Instruction A — transfer USDC, price shares against pre-swap NAV, mint shares.
Must be followed by per-asset swap legs in the same transaction. For
`Fixed` vaults near their max_shares cap, the deposit is clamped to
remaining headroom rather than rejected.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: Token-2022 program (for c_vault share mint / burn / transfers).

accounts.name: base_token_program
docs: Classic SPL Token program (for USDC transfers).

accounts.name: user_info
docs: One PDA per (vault, user) — created on this user's first deposit into
this vault, reused (accumulated) on every deposit after that.

accounts.name: treasury_usdc_account
docs: Platform fee slice destination — treasury's USDC ATA.

accounts.name: fee_recipient_usdc_account
docs: Vault fee slice destination — vault's fee_recipient USDC ATA.

instructions.name: get_total_nav_view
docs: Read-only: returns live NAV, share price, and total shares.
Call with `.view()` from the TypeScript client — no wallet signature needed.

instructions.name: init_global_state
docs: Create the GlobalState singleton. Must be called once before any vault is created.

instructions.name: preview_deposit
docs: Read-only: shares a `usdc_amount` deposit would mint right now.
Call with `.view()` from the TypeScript client — no wallet signature needed.

instructions.name: preview_redeem
docs: Read-only: asset amounts + estimated USDC that burning `shares` would return.
Call with `.view()` from the TypeScript client — no wallet signature needed.

instructions.name: remove_eligible_base_mint
docs: Remove a mint from the eligible base_mint allowlist.

instructions.name: request_redeem
docs: Instruction 1 of 3 — burn shares, record proportional asset amounts, start 24hr cooldown.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: Token-2022 program (for c_vault share burn).

instructions.name: resume
docs: Resume vault after pause and reset the rolling high-price window.

instructions.name: set_deposit_disable
docs: Turn program-wide deposit blocking on or off.

instructions.name: set_emergency
docs: Turn global emergency mode on or off (blocks new deposits program-wide).

instructions.name: set_fee_recipient
docs: Update the pubkey that receives accrued performance fees for this vault.

instructions.name: set_paused
docs: Pause or unpause deposits for this vault (withdrawals always remain open).

instructions.name: set_redeem_cooldown
docs: Update the redeem cooldown (0 … 604 800 s). Applies to future redeems only.

instructions.name: swap_asset_to_sol
docs: Instruction 2 of 3 (per-asset, ViaSol leg 1) — swap one asset slot → wSOL.
The input amount is read from `RedeemState.asset_amount_in[asset_index]`.
Follow with `swap_sol_to_usdc` to finish converting the wSOL to USDC.

instructions.name: swap_asset_to_usdc
docs: Instruction 2 of 3 (per-asset) — after cooldown, swap one asset slot → USDC
directly (DirectUsdc route). The input amount is read from
`RedeemState.asset_amount_in[asset_index]`; net USDC is accumulated into
`pending_usdc`. Call once per DirectUsdc asset before `claim`.

instructions.name: swap_sol_to_asset
docs: Permissionless: deploy the vault's pending wSOL into one ViaSol asset.
Amount = total_pending_sol × sol_target_bps[idx] / 10_000; no-ops if 0.

accounts.name: signer
docs: Permissionless caller — any signer may deploy pending wSOL.

instructions.name: swap_sol_to_usdc
docs: Instruction 2 of 3 (per-asset, ViaSol leg 2) — swap accumulated wSOL → USDC
for `asset_index`, deduct the performance fee, and accumulate net USDC into
`pending_usdc`. `wsol_amount` is the wSOL produced by the prior
`swap_asset_to_sol` leg (a runtime value, not the stored asset amount).

instructions.name: swap_usdc_to_asset
docs: Permissionless: deploy the vault's pending USDC into one DirectUsdc asset.
Amount is derived on-chain from `vault.usdc_target_amount[idx]`; no-ops if 0.

accounts.name: signer
docs: Permissionless caller — pays tx fees; any signer may deploy pending funds.

instructions.name: swap_usdc_to_sol
docs: Permissionless: convert the vault's ViaSol-bound pending USDC → wSOL.
Size derived on-chain; no-ops if nothing is pending.

accounts.name: signer
docs: Permissionless caller — any signer may run the conversion.

accounts.name: wsol_owner_account
docs: token_owner_account_a/_b actually holds wSOL, passed again here so the
handler can read its balance before/after without guessing which slot.

instructions.name: update_platform_fee_bps
docs: Update the platform fee charged in basis points (max 20%).

instructions.name: update_treasury_addr
docs: Update the program-wide treasury recipient address.

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be > 0

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Unauthorized caller

errors.name: UnauthorizedAdmin
errors.msg: Only admin may call this instruction

errors.name: VaultPaused
errors.msg: Vault deposits are paused

errors.name: GenesisNotSeeded
errors.msg: Genesis deposit not seeded yet — only admin can make the first deposit

errors.name: EmergencyMode
errors.msg: Vault is in emergency mode — only withdrawals allowed

errors.name: NotInEmergency
errors.msg: Vault is not currently in emergency mode

errors.name: InsufficientShares
errors.msg: Insufficient shares to redeem

errors.name: StaleOracle
errors.msg: Oracle price is stale or unavailable

errors.name: InvalidOraclePrice
errors.msg: Oracle price is zero or negative

errors.name: SlippageExceeded
errors.msg: Slippage tolerance exceeded — try again

errors.name: CpiFailure
errors.msg: CPI call to external program failed

errors.name: InsufficientWsolBalance
errors.msg: wSOL balance is insufficient to cover WBTC + WETH swap legs

errors.name: InvalidMint
errors.msg: Token mint does not match expected canonical mint

errors.name: AccountNotInitialized
errors.msg: Required token account is not initialised or has zero lamports

errors.name: IncorrectOwner
errors.msg: Token account owner does not match expected authority

errors.name: InvalidAccountsLength
errors.msg: remaining_accounts length must equal the number of active vault assets

errors.name: MathOverflow
errors.msg: Math overflow — value too large

errors.name: FeeTooHigh
errors.msg: Performance fee cannot exceed 20%

errors.name: MissingFeeRecipient
errors.msg: vault_fee_bps > 0 but no vault_fee_recipient account was provided

errors.name: TooEarlyRedeem
errors.msg: Redeem cooldown not elapsed — try again after unlock_time

errors.name: InvalidCooldown
errors.msg: Cooldown must be between 0 and 604 800 seconds (7 days)

errors.name: NothingToClaim
errors.msg: No USDC pending — swap redeemed assets to USDC first

errors.name: RedeemAlreadyPending
errors.msg: A redeem is already pending — claim it before starting a new one

errors.name: InvalidAllocation
errors.msg: Asset allocation BPS must sum to exactly 10 000

errors.name: TooManyAssets
errors.msg: Asset count exceeds the maximum allowed slots

errors.name: NoAssets
errors.msg: Asset list must contain at least one asset

errors.name: InvalidVaultId
errors.msg: vault_id must equal global_state.total_vaults (sequential creation enforced)

errors.name: MissingUsdcSolPool
errors.msg: usdc_sol_pool must be provided when any asset uses ViaSol routing

errors.name: AssetAlreadySwapped
errors.msg: This asset slot has already been swapped in the current redeem — cannot swap twice

errors.name: MissingMaxShares
errors.msg: A Fixed vault must declare a max_shares supply cap

errors.name: InvalidMaxShares
errors.msg: max_shares must be greater than zero

errors.name: ShareCapExceeded
errors.msg: Deposit would exceed the Fixed vault's max_shares supply cap

errors.name: DepositsDisabled
errors.msg: Deposits are disabled program-wide

errors.name: BaseMintNotEligible
errors.msg: Base mint is not on the company-approved eligible list

errors.name: EligibleMintListFull
errors.msg: Eligible base mint list is full

errors.name: EligibleMintAlreadyListed
errors.msg: Mint is already on the eligible base mint list

errors.name: EligibleMintNotFound
errors.msg: Mint is not on the eligible base mint list

errors.name: InvalidPendingAssetSlot
errors.msg: asset_index refers to a USDC-native or wSOL-native slot, which never enters the pending pool

types.name: AssetInfo
docs: Static configuration for one asset held by the vault.
Stored inline in `Vault.assets[i]`; slot is inactive when `mint == Pubkey::default()`.

fields.name: mint
docs: SPL mint of this asset.

fields.name: pool_address
docs: Orca Whirlpool pool used to swap this asset.
- `DirectUsdc`: this pool is USDC ↔ Asset
- `ViaSol`:     this pool is wSOL ↔ Asset  (USDC→wSOL uses `Vault.usdc_sol_pool`)

fields.name: pyth_feed_id
docs: Pyth price feed ID (32-byte hex) for this asset quoted in USD.

fields.name: allocation_bps
docs: Portfolio weight in basis points. Sum across all active assets must equal 10 000.

fields.name: decimals
docs: Token decimals — cached at init to avoid mint account reads in hot paths.

fields.name: route
docs: Routing strategy for USDC ↔ Asset swaps.

types.name: FundType
docs: Whether the vault's asset basket is frozen at creation or can grow over time.
- `Fixed`   — asset count is locked at init; `Vault.max_assets` sets the cap.
- `Dynamic` — new assets can be added on the fly; `Vault.max_assets` is ignored.

types.name: GlobalState
docs: Global configuration and counters shared across all vault instances.

fields.name: deposit_disable
docs: When true, new deposits are blocked program-wide; redemptions stay open.

fields.name: num_eligible_base_mints
docs: Count of active entries in `eligible_base_mints`.

fields.name: eligible_base_mints
docs: Company-approved stable mints that may be used as a vault's `base_mint`.

fields.name: fee_recipient
docs: Pubkey that receives accrued performance fees.
When `None`, defaults to the transaction signer at creation time.

fields.name: performance_fee_bps
docs: Performance fee in basis points (max 2_000).

fields.name: usdc_sol_pool
docs: Orca Whirlpool USDC↔wSOL first hop; None when all assets use DirectUsdc.

fields.name: assets
docs: 1–MAX_ASSETS entries; allocation_bps must sum to 10_000.

fields.name: fund_type
docs: Fixed or dynamic basket; defaults to Dynamic if omitted.

fields.name: max_shares
docs: Max outstanding shares; required for Fixed, ignored for Dynamic.

fields.name: total_nav
docs: Total portfolio value in USDC (6 decimals).

fields.name: share_price
docs: Current share price (PRICE_SCALE = 1e9 denominator).

fields.name: total_shares
docs: Outstanding shares at time of query.

types.name: PoolRoute
docs: How USDC reaches a particular asset inside the vault.
- `DirectUsdc` — single Whirlpool hop: USDC ↔ Asset
- `ViaSol`     — two-hop: USDC → wSOL (via `Vault.usdc_sol_pool`),
then wSOL → Asset (via `AssetInfo.pool_address`)

fields.name: shares_to_mint
docs: Shares the user would receive for `usdc_amount` (same math as `deposit`).

fields.name: total_nav
docs: Live NAV used for the quote (USDC, 6 decimals). 0 at genesis.

fields.name: share_price
docs: Share price implied by the live NAV (PRICE_SCALE = 1e9 denominator).

fields.name: total_shares
docs: Outstanding shares at time of quote.

fields.name: platform_fee
docs: Platform fee slice that would be deducted from `usdc_amount` (gross).

fields.name: vault_fee
docs: Vault performance fee slice that would be deducted from `usdc_amount` (gross).

fields.name: net_usdc
docs: `usdc_amount` after both fee slices — this is what shares are priced against.

fields.name: num_assets
docs: Number of active assets in `asset_amounts`.

fields.name: asset_amounts
docs: Proportional token amounts the user would be owed, indexed to match
`Vault.assets[0..num_assets]`. Unused slots are zero.

fields.name: estimated_usdc_value
docs: Oracle-priced USDC value of those assets (6 decimals) — gross, before
either fee slice, i.e. what the redeemed basket is worth right now.

fields.name: total_shares
docs: Outstanding shares at time of quote.

fields.name: vault_fee
docs: Vault performance fee slice — deducted per-asset during the redeem
swaps, before `pending_usdc` is ever set. Estimated here off the
gross oracle value since the real swaps haven't run yet.

fields.name: platform_fee
docs: Platform fee slice — deducted at `claim` time from `pending_usdc`.

fields.name: estimated_net_usdc
docs: Estimate of what `claim` would actually pay out to the user, i.e.
`estimated_usdc_value - vault_fee - platform_fee`.

fields.name: redeemable_shares
docs: Shares burned at request time; 0 means no active redeem.

fields.name: unlock_time
docs: Unix timestamp — swap / claim are blocked before this.

fields.name: pending_usdc
docs: Running total of net USDC accumulated across all per-asset swaps.
Incremented each time an asset is swapped; `claim` transfers this amount.

fields.name: num_assets
docs: Number of active asset slots at request time — how many entries of
`asset_amount_in` / `asset_swapped` / `asset_usdc_out` are meaningful.

fields.name: asset_amount_in
docs: Per-asset input amount (native token units) the redeemer must swap,
snapshotted at `request_redeem` time as the user's proportional slice of
the pool: `floor(pool_balance[i] × shares / total_shares)`.
Indexed to match `Vault.assets[i]`. The per-asset swap instructions read
directly from this array instead of re-deriving the proportion.

fields.name: asset_swapped
docs: Per-asset swap completion flag (indexed by `AssetInfo` slot).
`true` once asset[i] has been fully swapped to USDC; prevents re-swapping.

fields.name: asset_usdc_out
docs: Net USDC (after performance fee) received from each per-asset swap.
Slot [i] is only meaningful when `asset_swapped[i] == true`.

fields.name: vault_id
docs: Sequential global id assigned at creation (== GlobalState.total_vaults at
the time of creation). Part of every PDA seed for this vault.

fields.name: paused
docs: When true, new deposits are paused program-wide; redemptions stay open.

fields.name: total_shares
docs: Total outstanding shares (mirrors share_mint.supply, kept in sync).

fields.name: total_usdc_value
docs: Last-known total portfolio value in USDC (6 decimals).
Updated by: deposit (+usdc_amount), redeem (-usdc_out).

fields.name: total_pending_usdc
docs: Total undeployed USDC owed to inflow swaps (Direct and ViaSol groups).

fields.name: total_pending_sol
docs: Total undeployed wSOL owed to ViaSol asset legs. Zero until the
USDC→wSOL hop runs.

fields.name: usdc_target_amount
docs: USDC pending per asset — DirectUsdc non-native and non-wSOL-native ViaSol
slots. Zero for USDC-native and wSOL-native slots.

fields.name: sol_target_bps
docs: Fixed ViaSol wSOL split in bps (sums to 10_000 across non-wSOL-native
ViaSol assets). Set once in `create_etf`; immutable after creation.

fields.name: redeem_cooldown_secs
docs: Cooldown (seconds) from request_redeem → swap / claim allowed.
Defaults to REDEEM_COOLDOWN_SECS (86 400). Configurable by admin.

fields.name: fund_type
docs: Whether this vault's asset basket is fixed or can grow dynamically.

fields.name: max_shares
docs: Hard cap on total outstanding shares (supply cap) for a `Fixed` vault.
Deposits that would push `total_shares` above this are rejected. Only
enforced when `fund_type == Fixed`; `None` means uncapped (always the
case for `Dynamic`).

fields.name: usdc_sol_pool
docs: Orca Whirlpool pool for USDC ↔ wSOL.
Required (Some) when any asset uses `route == ViaSol`; None for USDC-only vaults.

fields.name: num_assets
docs: Number of active asset slots (1–MAX_ASSETS).
Slots `[0..num_assets)` are active; remaining slots are zeroed.

fields.name: assets
docs: Per-asset configuration.
